news.analysis: Perine had himself a nice game on Sunday. He wasn't very productive on the ground, but he was able to make up for that by getting into the end zone once and getting involved in the receiving game. He will continue to see meaningful touches for this offense moving forward, though he won't be a good fantasy option as long as he's behind Chase Brown in the pecking order.

Detroit's secondary will be considerably stronger when he's back and in the full swing of things.

news.contents: The Detroit Lions are planning for safety Kerby Joseph (knee) to make his 2026 season debut this Sunday when the Lions host the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, according to head coach Dan Campbell.
